events.verdict: McCollum (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position alongside of Giddey (CHI).\
Buzelis (CHI) is aligning himself alongside Coulibaly's (WAS) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Buzelis (CHI) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex or touches the backboard.
Vucevic (CHI) maintains verticality and absorbs the ensuing contact as he defends Sarr's (WAS) shot attempt.
Giddey (CHI) and Sarr (WAS) pursue the rebound and Giddey cleanly deflects the loose ball away.
George (WAS) and Jones (CHI) make incidental foot contact on the perimeter.
Buzelis (CHI) jumps to contest Coulibaly's (WAS) dunk attempt and any contact that occurs is marginal.
Champagnie (WAS) extends his arms into Jones (CHI) as he moves to set the pick.
Vucevic (CHI) and Sarr (WAS) both step into the lane prior to the release of Jones' (CHI) free throw attempt.
George (WAS) releases away from Buzelis (CHI) as he steps back.
Jones (CHI) steps forward into George's (WAS) lower body, initiating illegal contact that causes him to lose his balance.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: George (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
